_note: Declarations for the Recovery page. Everything here is a DECLARATION, not a measurement: no generated report under reports/ carries it, so the builder cannot derive it. Each entry states its own 'why'. Measured figures never appear in this file -- they are read from the reports named in scripts/webui/recovery/build_recovery.py and are marked evidence=measured in the published payload.

memoryIndexSections._why: memory/game_data/README.md groups its topic files under bold lane headings. The heading text is prose, so the heading-to-lane mapping is declared here rather than guessed from the words. The per-file level and line count beside each row ARE parsed from that table.

lanes._why: The lane list and each lane's one-line scope restate memory/game_data/README.md. A lane is an editorial grouping of content kinds; nothing measures it.

unity_assets.label: Unity assets
unity_assets.blurb: Asset bundles and FMV: models, materials, textures, prefabs, scenes, video.
unity_assets.blurbZh: 资源包与过场影片：模型、材质、贴图、预制体、场景、视频。

world.label: World
world.blurb: Streaming chunks, terrain, dynamic streaming, irradiance volumes.
world.blurbZh: 流式区块、地形、动态流送、辐照度体积。

audio.label: Audio
audio.blurb: Wwise banks and media, from bank container to what is actually named.
audio.blurbZh: Wwise 音频库与媒体，从容器到实际命名。

gameplay.label: Gameplay
gameplay.blurb: Authored config tables joined to native action contracts.
gameplay.blurbZh: 配置表与原生行为契约的连接。

text.label: Text
text.blurb: Presentation-facing table text and JsonData conversations.
text.blurbZh: 面向展示的表格文本与 JsonData 对话。

catalog.label: Catalog
catalog.blurb: Global path/hash catalogs and the opaque bundle manifest.
catalog.blurbZh: 全局路径/哈希目录与不透明的资源清单。

code.label: Code
code.blurb: Lua mission and consumer scripts, plus runtime IFix patches.
code.blurbZh: Lua 任务与消费者脚本，以及运行时 IFix 补丁。
code.ownedElsewhere: memory/webui/story_recovery.md for Lua; IFixPatch has a reader but no durable conclusions

story.label: Story carriers
story.blurb: Activation and placement carriers read out of Bundle and JsonData. No block of its own.
story.blurbZh: 从 Bundle 与 JsonData 中读出的激活与放置载体，没有独立的数据块。

extraction.label: Extraction
extraction.blurb: The reader itself, and how far each family's reader is proven.
extraction.blurbZh: 读取器本身，以及每个家族的读取器被证明到哪一步。

shared.label: Shared containers
shared.blurb: Level-1 files every lane depends on: the block inventory, shared containers, CABMap.
shared.blurbZh: 所有通道共用的第 1 层文件：数据块清单、共享容器、CABMap。
shared.appliesToAllLanesWhy: memory/game_data/README.md heads this section 'Level 1 -- all lanes': its conclusions hold for every block type, so a corpus-wide level breakdown must credit them to all lanes rather than to a lane with no block of its own.

cross_lane.label: Cross-lane
cross_lane.blurb: Serialization framework, the native read path, and what is settled versus open.
cross_lane.blurbZh: 序列化框架、原生读取路径，以及已定论与未决内容。

provenance.label: Provenance
provenance.blurb: Audit variants of other blocks; they carry no separate content.
provenance.blurbZh: 其他数据块的审计副本，不含独立内容。

blockTypeLanes._why: memory/game_data/README.md names block types in collapsed form (`Audio` + `InitialAudio`, `Audit*`, per-language variants). The installed VFS enum emits concrete names. Pairing the two is a reading of that table, not a measurement, and an unmapped observed block type fails the build closed so a client update is noticed.

unreachableFromStaticData._why: These are recorded eliminations, not open work. A generated report can show that nothing was recovered; only the owning memory topic records that nothing CAN be recovered from installed data alone. Presenting them as 'todo' would invite the same dead ends.

items.title: HIRC object types 0x0A-0x0D
items.detail: The engine's own shipped HIRC parser skips these types, so no installed byte establishes what they mean. Framing alone remains available.
items.detailZh: 游戏自带的 HIRC 解析器直接跳过这些类型，因此安装数据本身无法确定其含义，只能得到帧结构。

items.title: The consumer of terrain LAYER_C
items.titleZh: 地形 LAYER_C 的消费者
items.detail: The array is decoded end to end, but the recorded answer for what reads it was disconfirmed on re-test. No current static evidence names a consumer.
items.detailZh: 该数组已完整解码，但此前记录的消费者结论在复测中被推翻，目前没有静态证据指明消费者。

items.title: Runtime-consumer questions in general
items.detail: What a decoded record does at runtime -- which branch is taken, which value is effective -- is not in the installed bytes. It needs a bounded capture against the exact selected build, not more static decoding.
items.detailZh: 解码记录在运行时的实际行为（走哪个分支、哪个值生效）不在安装数据中，需要针对选定版本的有界捕获，而非继续静态解码。

levelCaveats._why: The page's central honesty rule. It is an editorial statement about what the measured numbers do and do not prove, so it is declared rather than derived.

namedIsNotUnderstood.text: Named bytes are a level-2/3 result: every byte is inside a framed, named field. That is not level 4. A 100% named family can still have fields whose meaning is unproven.
namedIsNotUnderstood.textZh: “已命名字节”是第 2/3 层的结果：每个字节都落在已划分、已命名的字段内，但这不是第 4 层。100% 命名的家族仍可能有含义未经证明的字段。

documentedTopicsAreNotBytes.text: A lane's level strip counts documented topic files, not bytes. A level being reached means at least one conclusion at that level exists for that lane, never that the lane's data is understood at that level.
documentedTopicsAreNotBytes.textZh: 通道的层级条统计的是已记录的主题文件，而非字节。某层被点亮只表示该通道在该层至少有一条结论，不表示该通道的数据在该层已被理解。
